thread:
lina: FYI when I load a saved per-route view with model breakdown the console spikes to ~1.8s. looks like N+1 model stats fetches. noticed this on mobile and desktop.

henry: yeah i've been seeing that. we do a route summary call then loop over pinned model ids -> /api/model/metrics which is killing the critical path.

arun: we should consider an aggregated API that returns route + models in a single payload. also can attach cache-control hints so the client can serve stale-while-revalidate for fast UX.

lina: agreed. but product question: should aggregated data be enabled by default? it increases telemetry consumption. we need to respect org sampling quotas.

maya: suggestion: default aggregated=false. expose a per-view flag "include_model_telemetry" persisted on saved queries. show a tiny badge "telemetry: detailed" when enabled.

henry: api idea: GET /api/console/views/{id}?expand=route,models&model_sample=0.1&cache_ttl=30 
Response meta: {returned_expand: "models", model_sample_rate: 0.1, quota_status: "ok"} + body. client uses meta to show whether we sampled or fell back.

arun: add prefetch_level param values: none|route|pinned_models|all. server can downgrade pinned_models -> route if quota exceeded. return header X-Prefetch-Downgrade: true for telemetry.

ops-billing: if you add a combined endpoint please emit meter tags like meter=console_view.telemetry; include org_id and view_id. billing needs to attribute extra telemetry usage. also emit event when downgrade occurs.

maya: UX copy draft: "Enable detailed per-model telemetry (may increase telemetry usage and affect quotas)." Tooltip: "We may sample or fall back to route-level metrics if your org quota is constrained." show an inline estimate: "~ +0.5s / view on first load" or precise number from perf tests.

henry: console-bot ran perf: staging with combined endpoint -> median load 380ms (was 1.8s), p95 920ms (was 3.2s). small extra backend CPU but much better UX. run id: cprefetch-2026-03-19-1.

arun: rollout plan: 1) add endpoint behind feature flag, 2) client reads saved-view flag and sends expand param, 3) server returns meta about quota/sample, 4) ops exposes meter events + billing tag, 5) GA with default off.

lina: can we also add a cheap heuristic: if user opened the view twice within X seconds we keep a cached combined payload for that session. reduces repeat costs. maybe session cache key = org+user+view.

ops-billing: ok on caching but make sure meter events still fire on cache hits or we won't account. maybe use a lightweight call to /api/console/telemetry/charge that bills but doesn't return heavy payload when cached.

maya: i'll wire up the tiny checkbox mock and microcopy in figma. will add the "telemetry sample rate" disclosure in the details panel.

henry: i'll take API PR for combined endpoint and the meta header. plan to have a draft by tomorrow.

arun: i'll prototype server downgrade logic + cache-control headers in staging and post results.

lina: i'll file umbrella issue with acceptance criteria: combined endpoint, persisted saved-view flag, visible quota/cost hint, meter events for usage and downgrades, session caching with billing path. owners assigned.

console-bot: ci: console/prefetch-integration passed (build 4f5e6d). perf metrics uploaded to telemetry-dashboard link.

lina: thanks team. let's keep default off and ramp selectively to orgs that opt in during beta.

end of thread
